objectives.en: I can talk about other people's routines: She works in Eilat. He goes to the gym.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת לדבר על השגרה של אנשים אחרים: She works in Eilat. He goes to the gym.

objectives.en: I can spell the he/she/it form: works, watches, studies, has, does, goes.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת לאיית את הצורה של he/she/it: works, watches, studies, has, does, goes.

objectives.en: I can say the ending as /s/, /z/ or /ɪz/: works, lives, watches.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להגות את הסיומת כ-/s/, /z/ או /ɪz/: works, lives, watches.

warmup.en: Think of a friend or a family member. What do they do every day? You can already say I work. Today: She works.
warmup.he: חשבו על חבר/ה או בן/בת משפחה. מה הם עושים כל יום? אתם כבר יודעים לומר I work. היום תלמדו לומר She works – ונראה מה משתנה.

explanation.en: I work in Tel Aviv, but my sister works in Eilat. We live in Holon, and she lives near the beach. With he, she and it, the verb gets an -s.
explanation.he: I work in Tel Aviv, but my sister works in Eilat. כשמדברים על he, she או it – אדם אחד או דבר אחד – מוסיפים לפועל s.

explanation.en: he / she / it + verb + -s. This means any one person or thing: Noa, my dad, the shop, the bus. With I, you, we and they, nothing changes: I work, but she works.
explanation.he: he / she / it + פועל + s. זה כל אדם או דבר אחד: Noa, my dad, the shop, the bus. עם I, you, we, they לא משתנה דבר: I work, אבל she works.

rows: work → works, live → lives, eat → eats
watch → watches, wash → washes, fix → fixes, go → goes, do → does
s, z, sh, ch, x, ge/dge sounds

explanation.en: Don't forget the -s. It is the most common mistake with the present simple: She works (not She work). But only with he, she and it: They work (not They works).
explanation.he: אל תשכחו את ה-s – זו הטעות הנפוצה ביותר בהווה פשוט: She works, לא She work. אבל רק עם he, she, it: They work, לא They works.

explanation.en: Learn three short forms by heart: has, does, goes. Two forms also change their vowel: does /dʌz/, says /sez/.
explanation.he: שלוש צורות קצרות כדאי לזכור בעל פה: has, does, goes. ובשתי צורות גם התנועה משתנה בהגייה: does נהגה /dʌz/, ו-says נהגה /sez/.

examples.en: The bus goes to the city centre.
My mum does yoga on Fridays.
examples.he: אמא שלי עושה יוגה בימי שישי.

vocab.def: to look at something for some time, like TV or a game
to stop doing something because it is complete

vocab.example: He washes the dishes after dinner.
She relaxes on the sofa after work.

vocab.def: to start working for the day (a shop, a bank); to make something not closed
to stop working for the day; to shut something
vocab.example: The bank closes at one on Fridays.

vocab.def: to make food hot and ready to eat
vocab.example: My dad cooks dinner every evening.
My uncle flies to London every month.

vocab.def: to use a bus, train or taxi to go somewhere
vocab.example: She takes the bus to work.

vocab.def: a person who lives near you
vocab.example: My neighbour walks her dog every morning.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew the present-tense verb changes for gender and number but not for person: 'I work' and 'he works' use the same Hebrew word. English works differently, so he, she and it need -s: I work, but he works.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית הפועל בהווה משתנה לפי מין ומספר, אבל לא לפי גוף: 'אני עובד' ו'הוא עובד' – אותה מילה בדיוק. באנגלית זה עובד אחרת: עם he, she, it מוסיפים s – I work, אבל he works.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: Hebrew has one 'i' vowel, but English has a short /ɪ/ and a long /iː/. So she lives /lɪvz/ (her home is there) can sound like she leaves /liːvz/ (she goes away). Keep lives short.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית יש תנועת 'אִי' אחת, ובאנגלית יש קצרה /ɪ/ וארוכה /iː/. לכן she lives /lɪvz/ (היא גרה) עלול להישמע כמו she leaves /liːvz/ (היא עוזבת). ב-lives התנועה קצרה.

prompt.en: Match each verb with its he/she/it form.
prompt.he: התאימו כל פועל לצורה שלו עם he/she/it.

explanation.en: has, does and goes are short, special forms. study → studies (consonant + y), watch → watches (-ch + es), play → plays (vowel + y).
explanation.he: has, does, goes – צורות קצרות ומיוחדות. study → studies (עיצור + y), watch → watches (ch + es), play → plays (תנועה + y).

prompt.en: How do we write the he/she/it form? Sort the verbs.
prompt.he: איך כותבים את הצורה של he/she/it? מיינו את הפעלים.

explanation.en: Most verbs + s (buy → buys, because of vowel + y). -sh, -x, -o + es: washes, fixes, goes. Consonant + y → ies: tries, carries, flies.
explanation.he: רוב הפעלים + s (buy → buys, כי לפני ה-y יש תנועה). sh, x, o + es: washes, fixes, goes. עיצור + y → ies: tries, carries, flies.

exercises.audio_text: My brother works in a bank. He plays tennis on Fridays.
exercises.question: What does the speaker's brother do on Fridays?

1.en: He works in a bank, but that isn't what he does on Fridays.
1.he: הוא עובד בבנק, אבל זה לא מה שהוא עושה בימי שישי.

2.en: Listen again: he plays tennis – he doesn't just watch it.
2.he: הקשיבו שוב: he plays tennis – הוא משחק טניס, לא רק צופה בו.

explanation.en: He plays tennis on Fridays. Listen for the endings: works /s/, plays /z/.
explanation.he: He plays tennis on Fridays. שימו לב לסיומות: works עם /s/, plays עם /z/.

0.he: Lior = he, ולכן מוסיפים s: works.

2.en: Don't add is before the verb: Lior works.
2.he: לא מוסיפים is לפני הפועל: Lior works.

3.en: working needs is and describes 'now'. For a job or a habit: Lior works.
3.he: working צריך is ומתאר משהו שקורה עכשיו. לעבודה קבועה או להרגל: Lior works.

explanation.en: One person (he) + verb-s: Lior works in a restaurant.
explanation.he: אדם אחד (he) + פועל עם s: Lior works in a restaurant.

exercises.question: Dana and Tom are from Israel. Now…
options: Dana and Tom lives in London.
Dana and Tom live in London.
Dana and Tom are live in London.

0.en: Dana and Tom = they, so no -s: live.
0.he: Dana and Tom = they, ולכן בלי s: live.

1.en: Dana alone = she, so she needs -s: Dana lives.
1.he: Dana לבד = she, ולכן צריך s: Dana lives.

3.en: Don't add are before the verb: Dana and Tom live.
3.he: לא מוסיפים are לפני הפועל: Dana and Tom live.

explanation.en: The -s is only for one person or thing (he/she/it). Two people = they → live.
explanation.he: ה-s רק לאדם אחד או לדבר אחד (he/she/it). שני אנשים = they, ולכן live.

prompt.en: Say the verbs out loud. Which one has an extra syllable /ɪz/ at the end?
prompt.he: אמרו את הפעלים בקול. באיזה מהם הסיומת היא הברה נוספת /ɪz/?

hint.en: Listen for the verb that ends in a ch sound.
hint.he: חפשו את הפועל שמסתיים בצליל צ'.

explanation.en: After ch, sh, s, x and similar sounds, -es is an extra syllable: watch-es /ˈwɒtʃɪz/.
explanation.he: אחרי ch, sh, s, x וצלילים דומים, הסיומת es היא הברה נוספת: watch-es /ˈwɒtʃɪz/.

prompt.en: Write the correct form of the verb.
prompt.he: כתבו את הצורה הנכונה של הפועל.

exercises.text: Kenji ___ (watch) TV every evening, and his sister ___ (study) at the library.
answers: watches
studies

hint.en: watch ends in -ch. study ends in a consonant + y.
hint.he: watch מסתיים ב-ch, ו-study מסתיים בעיצור + y.

feedback.en: Kenji = he: add -es after ch → watches.
feedback.he: Kenji = he: אחרי ch מוסיפים es → watches.
his sister = she, ולכן study → studies.

explanation.en: watch → watches (-ch + es). study → studies (y → ies).
explanation.he: watch → watches (אחרי ch מוסיפים es). study → studies (y הופך ל-ies).

prompt.en: Write the correct form of the verb.
prompt.he: כתבו את הצורה הנכונה של הפועל.

exercises.text: My dad ___ (have) a car, but he ___ (go) to work by bus. He ___ (finish) work at six.
answers: has
goes
finishes

hint.en: Two of these verbs are special: have and go.

feedback.he: My dad = he, ולכן have → has.

feedback.en: go ends in -o, so add -es: goes.
feedback.he: go מסתיים ב-o, ולכן מוסיפים es: goes.

explanation.en: have → has, go → goes, finish → finishes. All three because the subject is he (my dad).
explanation.he: have → has, go → goes, finish → finishes – בכולם כי הנושא הוא he (my dad).

prompt.en: Rewrite the sentence about Omer. Start with Omer.
prompt.he: כתבו את המשפט מחדש על עומר. התחילו ב-Omer.

exercises.source: I watch TV and go to bed at eleven.
answers: Omer watches TV and goes to bed at eleven.
Omer watches TV and he goes to bed at eleven.
Omer watches TV, and he goes to bed at eleven.
Omer watches TV and goes to bed at 11.
Omer watches TV and he goes to bed at 11.

wrong_feedback.match: Omer watch TV and go to bed at eleven.

feedback.en: Omer = he, so both verbs need -es: watches, goes.
feedback.he: Omer = he, ולכן שני הפעלים צריכים es: watches, goes.

wrong_feedback.match: Omer watches TV and go to bed at eleven.

feedback.en: Good start! The second verb needs it too: goes.
feedback.he: התחלה טובה! גם הפועל השני צריך: goes.

wrong_feedback.match: Omer watch TV and goes to bed at eleven.

feedback.en: The first verb needs -es too: watches.
feedback.he: גם הפועל הראשון צריך es: watches.

wrong_feedback.match: Omer watchs TV and gos to bed at eleven.

feedback.en: Verbs ending in -ch and -o take -es: watches, goes.
feedback.he: פעלים שמסתיימים ב-ch וב-o מקבלים es: watches, goes.

explanation.en: Every verb with he/she/it takes -s/-es, even the second one after and.
explanation.he: כל פועל עם he/she/it מקבל s או es – גם הפועל השני, אחרי and.

exercises.source: אחי עושה יוגה ויש לו חתול.
answers: My brother does yoga and has a cat.
My brother does yoga and he has a cat.
My brother does yoga, and he has a cat.
My brother does yoga, and has a cat.
My brother does yoga and has got a cat.
My brother does yoga and he's got a cat.
My brother does yoga, and he's got a cat.

hint.en: Two verbs, and both are special with he: do and have.
hint.he: שני פעלים, ושניהם מיוחדים עם he: עושה = do, יש לו = have.

wrong_feedback.match: My brother do yoga and have a cat.

feedback.en: My brother = he, so both verbs change: does, has.
feedback.he: My brother = he, ולכן שני הפעלים משתנים: does, has.

wrong_feedback.match: My brother does yoga and have a cat.

feedback.en: have → has with he, she and it.
feedback.he: עם he, she, it: have → has.

wrong_feedback.match: My brother makes yoga and has a cat.

feedback.en: Hebrew uses one verb for do and make, but English says do yoga.
feedback.he: בעברית 'עושה' מכסה גם do וגם make, אבל באנגלית אומרים do yoga.

explanation.en: The Hebrew verb is the same for 'I' and 'he', but English adds an ending: he does, he has. And remember: do yoga, not make yoga.
explanation.he: בעברית 'עושה' זהה עם 'אני' ועם 'הוא', אבל באנגלית יש לצורה של he סיומת: he does, he has. ושימו לב: do yoga, לא make yoga.

exercises.sentence: My mum teach English at a high school.
answers: My mum teaches English at a high school.
My mum teaches English in a high school.

hint.en: my mum = she. The verb ends in -ch.
hint.he: my mum = she – אדם אחד. והפועל מסתיים ב-ch.

explanation.en: my mum = she, so the verb needs -es: teach → teaches (an extra syllable: TEACH-iz).
explanation.he: my mum = she, ולכן הפועל צריך es: teach → teaches (עם הברה נוספת: TEACH-iz).

answers: Sara studies English every evening.

explanation.en: Consonant + y → ies: study → studies. (But vowel + y → s: play → plays.)
explanation.he: עיצור + y → ies: study → studies. (אבל תנועה + y → s: play → plays.)

prompt.en: Read Noa's blog post and answer the questions.
prompt.he: קראו את הפוסט של נועה וענו על השאלות.

exercises.title: My grandmother Rina
exercises.passage: My grandmother Rina is 74, and she is very busy! She lives in a small house in Rehovot. Every morning, she gets up at six and walks to the park with her dog, Shoko. She teaches English to children three times a week. On Tuesdays, she goes to a pottery class. In the evening, she reads or watches old films on her laptop. Every Friday, the whole family comes to her house for dinner. She cooks, and we wash the dishes!

0.en: The pottery class is on Tuesdays – once a week.
0.he: חוג הקרמיקה הוא בימי שלישי – פעם בשבוע.

2.en: She walks to the park every morning, not three times a week.
2.he: היא הולכת לפארק כל בוקר, לא שלוש פעמים בשבוע.

explanation.en: She teaches English to children three times a week.
explanation.he: כתוב: She teaches English to children three times a week.

explanation.en: She gets up at six.
explanation.he: היא קמה בשש – מוקדם.

questions.statement: Rina washes the dishes on Fridays.

explanation.en: She cooks, and we (the family) wash the dishes.
explanation.he: היא מבשלת, ו-we (המשפחה) שוטפים את הכלים.

answers: dog

explanation.en: ...walks to the park with her dog, Shoko.
explanation.he: כתוב: walks to the park with her dog, Shoko.

explanation.en: Notice all the -s verbs: lives, gets up, walks, teaches, goes, reads, watches, comes, cooks.
explanation.he: שימו לב לכל הפעלים עם s: lives, gets up, walks, teaches, goes, reads, watches, comes, cooks.

prompt.en: Listen and write what you hear.

exercises.audio_text: She does her homework and then watches TV.
answers: She does her homework and then watches TV.

hint.en: Two verbs, both with he/she endings.
hint.he: שני פעלים, ולשניהם סיומת של she.

explanation.en: does /dʌz/ and watches /ˈwɒtʃɪz/: listen for the ending on both verbs.
explanation.he: does /dʌz/ ו-watches /ˈwɒtʃɪz/ – הקשיבו לסיומת בשני הפעלים.

exercises.target: My sister lives in Eilat. She teaches English and watches films at night.

focus.en: Hear the endings: lives /z/, teaches /ɪz/, watches /ɪz/. teaches and watches have an extra syllable: TEACH-iz, WATCH-iz.
focus.he: שימו לב לסיומות: lives עם /z/, ו-teaches ו-watches עם /ɪz/. ב-teaches וב-watches יש הברה נוספת: TEACH-iz, WATCH-iz.

explanation.en: Three verbs about one person, so three endings.
explanation.he: שלושה פעלים על אדם אחד – ולכן שלוש סיומות.

task.en: Write 5-6 sentences about a person you know (a friend, a family member or a neighbour): where they live, their job or studies, and what they do every day or every week.
task.he: כתבו 5-6 משפטים על אדם שאתם מכירים (חבר/ה, בן/בת משפחה או שכן/ה): איפה הוא/היא גר/ה, במה הוא/היא עובד/ת או מה לומד/ת, ומה הוא/היא עושה כל יום או כל שבוע.

exercises.model_answer: My friend Amir lives in Nazareth. He studies engineering at a university in Haifa, so he takes the bus every morning. He has a part-time job in a phone shop. On Fridays, he plays football with his cousins. In the evening, he watches TV series and relaxes.

checklist.en: Every verb after he/she/it has -s or -es: lives, watches, studies.
checklist.he: כל פועל אחרי he/she/it מקבל s או es: lives, watches, studies.

checklist.en: has, does, goes – not haves, dos, gos.
checklist.he: has, does, goes – לא haves, dos, gos.

checklist.en: At least two time expressions: every morning, on Fridays...
checklist.he: לפחות שני ביטויי זמן: every morning, on Fridays...

checklist.en: Capital letters for names and places, and a full stop at the end of each sentence.
checklist.he: אות גדולה בשמות ובמקומות, ונקודה בסוף כל משפט.

explanation.en: Talking about other people's routines is where the -s matters most.
explanation.he: כשמספרים על השגרה של אנשים אחרים – שם ה-s הכי חשובה.

key_points.en: he / she / it + verb-s: She works. He lives in Eilat.
key_points.he: he / she / it + פועל עם s: She works. He lives in Eilat.

key_points.en: Spelling: watches, washes, goes (+ es) · studies, flies (y → ies) · plays (+ s) · has.
key_points.he: איות: watches, washes, goes (+ es) · studies, flies (y → ies) · plays (+ s) · has.

key_points.en: No -s with I, you, we, they: They work.
key_points.he: בלי s עם I, you, we, they: They work.
